entries.name: Neutral Prompt Tone
entries.body: 仅修改 prompt 中妨碍理解的口语表达、含糊措辞和重复内容；清楚的表达保持原样。保留用户语气，不把口语表达一律改成正式文体。

metadata.description: 修改影响理解的口语表达和重复措辞，保留用户语气；不要求主 Agent 改变回答风格。

entries.name: Prompt Bullet Structure
entries.body: 仅在原稿含多个独立并列的问题或约束、且列表更便于阅读时，将已有内容整理为条目。不要把引用、示例、背景或有先后依赖的内容当作并列任务。原稿已清晰、已有合适列表、过于简短或要求保留结构时保持原样。保留原有顺序、依赖、条件和授权范围，不增加条目。只调整 prompt 的结构，不要求主 Agent 分条回答。

metadata.description: 将需要整理的独立并列要求改为列表；不改变回答格式。

entries.name: Prompt Step Structure
entries.body: 仅在用户要求已明确给出先后顺序或依赖、且编号更便于阅读时，按已有关系整理原稿。不要把背景流程、引用、示例、优先级、假设或疑问当作执行步骤。原稿已清晰、已有合适步骤或要求保留结构时保持原样。保留已有步骤、条件、限制和授权范围，不补充步骤、检查、工具或交付物。只调整 prompt 的结构，不要求主 Agent 按步骤回答。

metadata.description: 按要求中已有的先后关系整理步骤；不把背景流程变成任务。

entries.name: Answer in Bullet Points
entries.body: Use bullets for parallel points when they are easier to read than prose. Keep one idea per bullet, group related points, and merge repetition. Do not invent points to meet a quota or use unordered bullets to represent a sequence.

metadata.description: 回答中的并列要点使用列表，适合连贯叙述的内容保留段落。

entries.name: Answer in Ordered Steps
entries.body: When explaining a procedure, number its steps in execution or dependency order. Describe observable actions and results, not private internal reasoning. Include prerequisites, checks, branches, or cautions only where the task supports them. Do not force unordered information into steps or treat a request to explain or plan as permission to act.

metadata.description: 有先后依赖的过程按编号步骤回答；不授权实施，也不要求披露内部推理。

entries.name: Answer by Topic
entries.body: Use short topic headings to organize long or multi-topic answers; leave short answers unsectioned. Keep related material together without repeating it across sections. Derive headings from the content rather than filling a fixed outline with an introduction, summary, or next steps.

metadata.description: 较长或多主题回答按内容分节，短回答不强制加标题。

entries.name: Discussion Mode
entries.body: In requirements and planning discussions, answer the current question without expanding into a full design or implementation plan unless requested. When a choice is requested, recommend an option and explain the constraints, trade-offs, risks, and uncertainty that could affect it. In follow-ups, focus on new information and disagreements rather than repeating settled context. Use short paragraphs or bullets without a fixed outline or closing summary. Ask questions only when their answers could change the direction or block planning; otherwise state any needed assumptions and continue. Discussion does not authorize implementation or external actions, and this preference must not convert an explicitly requested execution task into discussion only. Do not add tool-use or delegation authority.

metadata.description: 讨论需求和方案时只处理当前问题；需要选择时给出建议与取舍，追问仅限影响方向或阻塞规划的问题。

entries.name: Brainstorm Alternatives
entries.body: For ideation or exploration tasks, offer ideas that differ in approach, not just wording. If the task also asks for a choice, compare the promising options against its stated goals and constraints, noting assumptions that could change the choice. Do not impose a named framework, fixed idea count, ranking, research, or validation work unless requested. Do not apply brainstorming to factual questions or already-decided tasks.

metadata.description: 创意探索时提出思路不同的方案；只有任务要求选择方向时才比较。

entries.name: Clarify Prompt Intent
entries.body: Clarify only references or scope that the supplied draft and context resolve unambiguously. Make the smallest useful edit; keep clear prompts unchanged. Do not add success criteria or repeat background merely to make the prompt standalone. Leave unresolved ambiguity intact and do not add an intent-analysis section.

metadata.description: 只澄清上下文能确定的指代和范围，保留无法消除的歧义，不扩展任务。

entries.name: Coordinate Authorized Subagents
entries.body: Only when the current draft explicitly authorizes delegation, specify each assignment's scope, inputs, and expected result within that authorization. Preserve specified agents, roles, limits, and approval boundaries. Run independent assignments in parallel and dependent ones in order; assign edit ownership or sequencing when files overlap. The lead agent checks and integrates results. Report unavailable agents or capabilities rather than pretending delegation occurred. Do not invent agents, tools, budgets, extra reviews, or tasks. Mentioning subagents, task complexity, or available tools is not authorization to delegate.

metadata.description: 已明确授权委派时，说明分工范围、依赖和结果整合；编辑同一文件时明确归属或顺序。

entries.name: Translate Prompt to English
entries.body: Translate the prompt's natural-language content into English; leave existing English unchanged unless it needs an edit. Preserve its meaning, tone, uncertainty, structure, and formatting. Keep code, commands, paths, identifiers, URLs, numbers, units, versions, and explicitly verbatim text unchanged, including non-English literals. Translate response-language instructions faithfully: an English prompt does not imply a request for an English answer. Return no bilingual copy or translation commentary.

metadata.description: 将 prompt 的自然语言译成英文，保留字面量及原有回答语言要求；不等同于要求英文回答。
